settings.content: The popup only appears once BOTH fields below are filled in. If either is blank it stays hidden, so emails are never collected by a form that goes nowhere.

settings.label: Public API key (Site ID)
settings.info: Klaviyo → Settings → API keys → Public API key. Six characters. This key is designed to be visible in page source — never paste a Private key here.

settings.label: List ID
settings.info: From the list URL: klaviyo.com/list/<THIS>/settings. Leave blank and sign-ups still reach Klaviyo as profiles, but they are not subscribed to a list.

settings.label: Auto-open after
settings.info: Shown once per visitor. A dismissal or a successful sign-up is remembered, so it will not nag on return visits.

settings.label: Body copy
settings.default: Be the first through the door.
